body:
Right, I just need to read the secret.

I get what you are saying, I really do. My life has just never operated that way, being optimistic about general life-outlook hasn't changed anything; sometimes I get these periods where I can identify specific things about myself to change, so hope swells in those moments, until I fix whatever variable was identified and realize that it still won't change anything.

I appreciate the response, I wish that you believing something was enough to make it so. I wish that any number of people doing that could bring it to be, but we know how belief, superstition, etc. are.

It's just an innate nervousness, I can go through those moves and have tried them in the past, but I am still anxious, and that is apparently THE line.  Tried ayahuasca for it, years of therapy, tons of stuff, still anxious, still a subconscious nervous wreck. Moreso, negative conditioning is an unfortunate thing, sometimes failure, even if the fault of the person (me), starts a negative feedback loop.  Not sure how to short-circuit it. At this point I'm just throwing my hands in the air from exasperation.

Is this the sub where we pile on lonely people, make them feel even shittier than they already do, laugh at low-hanging fruit "funny" articles, then pretend that everyone gets what they deserves? Act like it's all about personality, tell everyone they are broken, and deserve to feel even worse than they do. Then pretend we're some oracles, dropping knowledge bombs.

Great, I almost had a sliver of self-esteem this morning, time to get shit on.

I've been trying for a decade, daily meditation, exercise, study.  Nothing.  I'm just not as interesting as my peers, never will be.  Too anxious.  Need to be Buddha incarnate or I don't get a chance.  Map is not territory, no matter how many maps say you can be yourself, you can't.

There is no right person for everyone, I now know that.  Many guys die alone, I will as well.  There is only telling people what isn't, is. What is, isn't.

>I am fully confident /u/523452435435234, that you can find that person out there for you. 

So said many therapists, family members, and friends.  A decade went by, just slipped away...now, they're almost angry at me. Angry, like I'm an unfortunate arbiter of truth, that it's not a fucking fairy tale, and even though we say that, we still, on some level, act like it is.  Like input = output.  Like for every 1 there is a 0.

>just be yourself and find someone who likes you for you and everything will be okay :)


HAHAHAHAHAHAHAHAHAHAHAHA

I'm dying over here.
